description:
Consolidation Determination Notice

DLA Troop Support is providing this consolidation notice to industry for a consolidated procurement of six (6) sole source helmet systems and associated components in accordance with FAR 7.107-3(b) as a result of formal approval. No solicitation will be issued with this notice.  DLA Troop Support will issue the solicitation in the near future on https://www.dibbs.bsm.dla.mil/.  

Point of contact: Mara.Cremen@dla.mil
